item.text:
## 1B.7 Research Note: Narendra Modi in 2024

**Assessment:** The 2024 record leans **positive** for 1B.7. The clearest evidence is institutional and technocratic: nuclear safety decisions were routed through AERB review, and India publicly reinforced strategic trade-control / nonproliferation machinery. I did **not** find a 2024 example where Modi clearly replaced expertise with ideological loyalists in a nuclear/security decision. The only counter-signal is broad political centralization around the PM/Home Minister, which is indirect rather than proof of expert displacement.

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [DGFT to discuss trade regime of dual-use goods, software and technology on Jan 30](https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2000179) | Press Information Bureau / DGFT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry | 28 Jan 2024 | https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2000179 | The government convened a strategic trade-controls conference with MEA and other agencies, focused on SCOMET compliance and dual-use controls, with UN 1540 and MTCR participation. This is direct evidence that Modi’s government invested in **specialized nonproliferation expertise and institutions**. | 1B.7, 1B.6 |
| [AERB Grants Permission for First Approach to Criticality of 500 MWe Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2039099&lang=2&reg=48) | Atomic Energy Regulatory Board / PIB | 30 Jul 2024 | https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2039099&lang=2&reg=48 | AERB approved first criticality only after phased core loading, multi-tier safety review, site inspection, and resident-site-observer oversight. This is strong evidence of **expert-led nuclear safety governance** and accident-prevention discipline. | 1B.7, 1B.3 |
| [AERB Grants Permission for First Approach to Criticality of Rajasthan Atomic Power Project - Unit 7](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2053554&lang=1&reg=3) | Atomic Energy Regulatory Board / PIB | 10 Sep 2024 | https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2053554&lang=1&reg=3 | AERB said the approval followed comprehensive safety assessments and continuing oversight by its resident observer team. This supports a finding that nuclear decisions were handled through **technical regulation**, not personalized or ideological discretion. | 1B.7, 1B.3 |
| [US National Security Advisor calls on Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2025954) | Prime Minister’s Office / PIB | 17 Jun 2024 | https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2025954 | The PMO says the meeting with NSA Jake Sullivan centered on iCET progress in semiconductors, AI, telecom, defence, critical minerals, and space. This is indirect but relevant evidence that Modi’s security posture was tied to **institutional techno-strategic channels** rather than purely ideological framing. | 1B.7 |
| [Ministry of Home Affairs: Year End Review 2024](https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2088945&lang=2&reg=48) | Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Home Affairs | 31 Dec 2024 | https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2088945&lang=2&reg=48 | The review highlights security apparatus upgrades, including DAE/DRDO-origin explosive detectors being handed to IB and security agencies, and a high-level review of MAC operations. This is positive evidence that the government was willing to lean on **technical institutions** for security tools. | 1B.7, 1B.6 |
| [Shri Amit Shah reassumes charge as Union Home Minister in North Block, New Delhi today](https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2024244&lang=2&reg=48) | Ministry of Home Affairs / PIB | 11 Jun 2024 | https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2024244&lang=2&reg=48 | The security portfolio remained publicly centered on Modi and Amit Shah, with strong “zero tolerance” political framing. This is only a **weak counter-signal**: it shows centralized political control, but not a specific case of experts being displaced by loyalists or ideologues in nuclear/security decisions. | 1B.7 |

### Search gap
- I found **no direct 2024 evidence** that Modi overrode expert nuclear/security advice in favor of ideologues or inner-circle loyalists.
- I also found **no clean counterexample** showing a nuclear/security decision made by loyalist fiat.
- So the best-supported reading is: **expert institutions were visibly active in 2024**, and the counterevidence is mostly about **political centralization**, not actual anti-expert decisionmaking.
